decisions.reason: It supports the firm's compliance and agency focus, has some early validation, and as a close-to-core software add-on it remains a low-cost option to keep open while demand becomes clearer.
As the flagship platform tied directly to the firm's strategic hosting direction, it is a core growth option that management would continue backing unless much stronger negative evidence appeared.

It is inexpensive and close to the existing hosting business, so it is still worth keeping for now, but its weaker differentiation and lower strategic importance make later rationalization more plausible than for the other products.

Because it is a new security-related extension of the core offer that likely serves legacy client needs with limited incremental investment, management would keep it on the market to learn more before making a harder commitment.
